scenarios.title: A｜接受
scenarios.setting: 同事临时有事，希望玩家帮忙处理一部分工作。

turns.text: Hey, I’m really behind today. Could you help me finish the client report?

turns.prompt: 你想愿意帮忙，并确认对方需要协助的部分，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. Which part do you need help with?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Which part do you need help with?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Yeah, I can take care of part of it. What still needs to be done?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I can take care of part of it. What still needs to be done?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I should have some time this afternoon. What do you need me to handle?

feedback.naturalExpression: I should have some time this afternoon. What do you need me to handle?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Sure. Send me what you have so far and I’ll take a look.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Send me what you have so far and I’ll take a look.
feedback.explanation: “so far”表示到目前为止，适合评价一段仍在进行的经历。

choices.text: Okay, I can help you do your work.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Which part do you need help with?
feedback.explanation: “your work”可能强调这是对方的活；“help you with this”把重点放在当前任务，语气更合作。

turns.text: Could you update the last two sections and check the numbers?

turns.prompt: 你想确认自己会负责哪些工作，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I’ll take care of those sections.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I’ll take care of those sections.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: No problem. When do you need them by?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. When do you need them by?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll check the numbers too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll check the numbers too.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: If you could finish it by four, that would be great.

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: That should be fine. I’ll let you know when it’s done.

feedback.naturalExpression: That should be fine. I’ll let you know when it’s done.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll aim to have it ready before four.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll aim to have it ready before four.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

scenarios.title: B｜协商工作量
scenarios.setting: 同事又希望玩家接手一个任务，但玩家自己已经有不少工作。

turns.text: Could you also take care of the presentation for tomorrow?

turns.prompt: 关于「工作被推给自己」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I can help, but I already have two things due today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can help, but I already have two things due today.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I might be able to, but I’d need to move some of my other work around.

feedback.naturalExpression: I might be able to, but I’d need to move some of my other work around.
feedback.explanation: “I might”表示一种可能的计划，还未完全决定。

choices.text: I’m happy to help, but I’m a little overloaded right now. Could we split the work?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to help, but I’m a little overloaded right now. Could we split the work?
feedback.explanation: “overloaded”表示任务或负担过多，能具体说明当前容量受限。

choices.text: I can take part of it. Which part is the highest priority?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can take part of it. Which part is the highest priority?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I have too many works today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can help, but I already have two things due today.
feedback.explanation: “work”指工作量时不可数，用“too much work”；也可用“too many tasks”强调任务数量。

turns.text: Could you just handle the first five slides?

turns.prompt: 关于「工作被推给自己」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, that’s manageable. I can do the first five.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s manageable. I can do the first five.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: That works better for me. Could you handle the rest?

feedback.naturalExpression: That works better for me. Could you handle the rest?
feedback.explanation: “works better for me”表示这个安排更适合自己，表达的是时间或条件上的偏好。

choices.text: Sure. If I only need to do the first five, I can fit that in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. If I only need to do the first five, I can fit that in.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Could we agree that I’ll handle the layout and you’ll update the content?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we agree that I’ll handle the layout and you’ll update the content?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.text: Yeah, I’ll take care of the content.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. That should work.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. That should work.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll send you my part when it’s ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll send you my part when it’s ready.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜礼貌拒绝
scenarios.setting: 在“工作被推给自己”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“礼貌拒绝”。

turns.text: Could you finish this for me before you leave today?

turns.prompt: 你担心行程衔接，想确认是否来得及，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t think I have enough time today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I don’t think I have enough time today.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’d like to help, but I need to finish my own deadline first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to help, but I need to finish my own deadline first.
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: I’m pretty tied up today, so I don’t think I can take this on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m pretty tied up today, so I don’t think I can take this on.
feedback.explanation: “tied up”在工作中表示忙得抽不开身，可用于解释目前无法接手更多任务。

choices.text: I can’t take on the whole task, but I could help you with one part.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t take on the whole task, but I could help you with one part.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: That’s your work. You should do it yourself.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I don’t think I have enough time today.
feedback.explanation: 拒绝额外任务可以明确；“do it yourself”容易激起对抗，说明职责或当前容量更有帮助。

turns.text: It’s pretty urgent. Are you sure you can’t fit it in?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m afraid not. I already have something due by the end of the day.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid not. I already have something due by the end of the day.
feedback.explanation: “I’m afraid”引出可能让对方失望或为难的信息，是缓和语气的说法，不一定表示害怕。

choices.text: If this needs to take priority, we should probably check with our manager first.

feedback.naturalExpression: If this needs to take priority, we should probably check with our manager first.
feedback.explanation: “take priority”表示优先处理，适合与已有任务一起确认先后顺序。

choices.text: I could look at it tomorrow morning, but I can’t promise anything today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I could look at it tomorrow morning, but I can’t promise anything today.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I don’t want to say yes and then miss both deadlines.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to say yes and then miss both deadlines.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry I couldn’t help this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry I couldn’t help this time.
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

choices.text: Thanks for understanding. If I finish early, I’ll let you know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding. If I finish early, I’ll let you know.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
